adminApi.description: Administrative API server settings. v1 relies on bind address and firewall policy for access control.

bind.description:
Network interface to bind the admin API server to, or false to disable it. Format is: "host" or "host:port". Host can be * to bind to all interfaces. Port is 21026 if not specified.

Recommended value for local operations: 127.0.0.1:21026
